l1_notes.uz: O'zbekchadagi 'shundaymi?' o'zgarmaydi, shuning uchun 'isn't it?' hamma joyda ishlatiladi.

body.text: You have given in your notice, haven't you?

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: I have. It was not an easy letter to write.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: You are not leaving the city, are you?

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: No, no. I do like it here — I just need different work.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Sorry, could I just ask one thing?

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: It wasn't. I do have enough money.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: As I was saying last week, I want to teach older students.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: You did say that. I wasn't really listening, was I?

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: You were tired. And I do understand — it was a long week.
